ALOO PARATHA SUNDAY
sundays call for my favorite aloo parathas and this recipe makes lovely packed with masala parathas that taste even better with cold dahi.

i use standard roti dough for the parathas and this recipe can be preped and ready within an hour so run to your kitchen and get started 

Ingredients: 

4  potatoes, peeled and boiled then mashed once cool
2 green chillies, finely chopped, adjust basis your personal price levels
1 onion, minced
handful of coriander leaves
1/2 tsp ginger garlic paste
1 tsp ground cumin
1 tbsp red chilli powder
1 tsp coriander powder
1/2 tsp garam masala
1 tbsp aamchur powder ( usually go with 1/2 tsp but 1 is my personal preference) 
1/2 tsp salt
1 tsp turmeric
1 tsp ghee / vegan  butter
